items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: The interviewer addresses the interviewee as 'Fred' ('Fred, you're one of the few that's left...'). The interviewee does not deny this but continues the conversation. There is no mention of a relationship with another person named Fred.

ctx.x: I made a pretty good... I got along pretty good by being in the saxophone. I think I made the best move. You see? I've made all those old fellas who are gone.
Fred, you're one of the few that's left of your age. The only one trouble I'm blessed was my time ago. And all of them. All of them were gone. I think I'm an only one there.
Henry, Sonny Henry. Yeah, he was a bad move. But he was always pretty strong. And I think sometime, I say, well, maybe add a little something to my life.
